payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in neural machine translation (NMT) systems, particularly in low-resourced language pairs.

claims.text: Advanced methods were employed to alleviate the data sparsity problem in NMT systems for low-resourced languages.
The mix-source method utilizes monolingual data of the target language to improve translation quality by mixing it with original source sentences.
Back Translation is mentioned as a method to increase the size of the parallel data, thereby addressing data sparsity.
